prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit / outpainting. ONE 16:9 landscape version of the attached approved artwork. This is ASPECT-RATIO REPAIR ONLY. Preserve its existing style, colors, figures, facial expressions, gestures, all identifiable objects and cultural architecture. Place the COMPLETE original 4:3 scene within the central three quarters of the wide canvas. Keep ALL original top/bottom content, including foreground instruments/books/figures and highest branches/buildings. Extend left/right edges with quiet adjacent terrain/architecture/materials that naturally follow existing perspective, lighting and brushwork. Do not crop, stretch, squeeze, redesign, simplify, substitute portraits or change the original palette. Keep all principal narrative groups and their relative positions/counts. No new characters, unrelated symbolism, labels, diagrams, large lettering, watermark or comparison panel. Small natural inscriptions already on source objects may remain. Maintain coherent anatomy, fine readable hands and distinctive activities; no duplicated limbs. Existing style is good: conservative lateral extension, not wholesale repainting. Preserve the following recognition cues in their existing contexts: 风暴中的海岸、异样的城市尺度、遗迹、水面与幽暗天空，保留环境造成的压迫感，不添加近景怪物。
